verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB exposes real programmatic surfaces of its own. Data-plane work goes through the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface. An official MCP server offers tools to list services, run SQL and read monitoring. CHKit provides typed commands to describe, validate, test and deploy schema and pipelines as code. However, nothing documents a control-plane/management API covering the UI's operations (creating or resizing clusters, configuring alert rules and destinations, roles/SSO, data sharing, batch-job controls), and there is no stated API–UI parity claim. missing for 10: a documented management API for cluster lifecycle, alerting, access control and job controls; an explicit API/UI parity commitment; independent or hands-on corroboration.
